segments.title: August
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! August is Azaadi From Average. Friendship Day, Independence Day and Raksha Bandhan, and a month about freedom: from commitment issues, from price hikes, and from quitting when life gets busy.

segments.title: ₹38.1L
segments.text: So, the number. Our August target for Kemps Corner is 38.1 lakh rupees. That's 27 per cent above last August. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 21 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 9.14 lakh, comebacks 4.57 lakh, and everything else 3.43 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 82 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 598 leads, 305 trials, and 82 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 29.8 lakh rupees, which is 78 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Price Ki Azaadi (Freedom From Price Hikes)
segments.text: First up, Price Ki Azaadi, freedom from price hikes. Over Freedom Weekend, the annual at twenty per cent off with fifteen extra days, and next year's renewal locked at this year's price. The plan is 5 buyers at about 1.76 lakh, so 8.78 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members and returning clients; annual renewers due Aug–Nov.

segments.title: Squad Goals, Squat Goals
segments.text: Next, for Friendship Day, Squad Goals, Squat Goals. Members book a free Squad Class for up to four friends. Friends who join get fifteen per cent off and friendship-band grip socks. Siblings count, it's Rakhi month. The plan is 11 buyers at about 17,200, so 1.89 lakh rupees.

segments.title: No Strings Attached
segments.text: Then, No Strings Attached. Two classes for nine ninety-nine, credited against a first month, and a break-up clause: if it's not for them after two weeks, what's left turns into a class pack. The plan is 22 buyers at about 16,200, so 3.56 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Freedom to Pause (Not Quit)
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Freedom to Pause, not quit. Renew for three months and get two Freedom Freezes for Ganpati and Diwali travel, or six months with a private and three freezes. The plan is 37 buyers at about 42,000, so 15.5 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Friendship Day, and members book free Squad Classes for their friends. Week two, Freedom Weekend from the thirteenth, with annuals and a 2028 price lock. Week three, Independence Day and Sibling Barre, and every trial hears about the break-up clause. Week four, every renewal leaves with Freedom Freezes for the festive season.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's August at Kemps Corner. 38.1 lakh rupees, four offers, and 82 buyers to welcome. Freedom looks good on you. So does a longer plan.
